teaching_explanation: A dirty read occurs when one transaction reads a value written by another transaction that later aborts. The reader has then consumed a value that never becomes part of the committed database state.

Connect the anomaly to recovery: if the writer aborts, the reader must not be allowed to commit a result derived from that transient value. ACA and strict schedules prevent this by delaying the read until the writer terminates.
